brief:
The Euro-Mediterranean Human Rights Monitor said the Israeli army acknowledged facts in five separate incidents that resulted in the deaths of 35 people in Gaza, but shielded those responsible from accountability following a delayed decision to open investigations, Shehab Wire reported.

The rights group characterized the army's approach as perpetuating denial while conceding to the underlying events. Officials faced no consequences despite the military's admission of what occurred in each case, according to the monitor's assessment.

The statement underscores tensions over Israeli military investigations into civilian casualties since operations in Gaza intensified following the October 2023 war. Rights organizations have repeatedly criticized the pace and scope of such inquiries.

title: Israeli army shielded officers in Gaza deaths despite acknowledging facts
